items.title: Public view counts now include TV co-viewers.
items.para: YouTube adds an estimate of people watching together on a TV screen. Past totals are not recalculated.
items.tip: Note the change date when comparing results or reporting reach to sponsors.

items.title: Creators can tag Amazon products in Reels and posts.
items.para: Up to 30 products per Reel and 20 per feed post, with affiliate attribution added automatically.
items.tip: Players can tag the gear they use. Agree disclosure rules with athletes first.

items.title: A test lets fans pick favourite sports and leagues.
items.para: Instagram would use those choices to surface real-time sports updates. It has not commented on the test.
items.tip: If it launches, live, timely content around matchdays may reach declared fans.

items.title: Edits adds speed curves and auto audio balancing.
items.para: Vary playback speed within a clip, balance audio levels and set how long text animations stay on screen.
items.tip: Use speed curves on goals and key plays in highlight Reels.
